payload.claim: The production packaging path never forwards `outcome.notes` into `render_pr_body`: the call at lines 815-835 passes `spec`, `gates`, `outcome.new_failures`, `outcome.reviews`, `outcome.rebut_result`, etc., but no `notes=outcome.notes` kwarg, so `render_pr_body`'s `notes` parameter (pr_body.py line 78) silently falls back to its default `""` for every real task. `_drive_cell` in session.py computes, hashes, and writes `notes`/`notes_sha256` onto `CellOutcome` (session.py lines 295-299, 1836-1837) and `_notes()` in pr_body.py renders it correctly when given text directly (as the unit tests in test_report.py exercise), but no code path reads `outcome.notes` outside session.py itself — grepping the repo for `outcome.notes` or `notes=` outside `session.py` turns up nothing. The result is that acceptance criterion 1 ("An implementer's notes reach the pull request body") is unmet in every actual packaged pull request even though every unit test for the pieces in isolation passes: the notes turn runs, spends money, writes `notes.json` to `task_dir`, and is then silently dropped on the floor before rendering — a default (`notes=""`) standing in for real, already-computed data, indistinguishable from a task that genuinely had nothing to report.
